dog.description_text:
This pet is available only through ACC New Hope partners. To adopt or foster, please complete the pre-screener form below. Inquiries sent directly to ACC will not receive a response.

Pre-Screener Form

Okapi came into the care center as a stray and we have limited history on her behavior in a home environment. Okapi has displayed fearful behavior in the care center, such as growling and snapping during medical examination, growling and staying at the back of her kennel when being leashed up, and being reluctant to re-enter her kennel. In calmer environments, she has shown social behavior with staff, and during the week she spent with her finder, they reported that she was social, affectionate, and playful. We recommend placement with a New Hope partner who can provide any necessary behavior modification (force-free, positive reinforcement-based) and re-evaluate behavior in a stable home environment before placement into a permanent home.
dog.name: Okapi
